text: Binary per-row measure from the OP's own title and argument text (current supplied text, including marked edits): 1 if the OP, in their own first-person voice, makes at least one vulnerable admission, meaning a disclosure of their own personal weakness, fear, failure, insecurity, mistake, struggle or emotionally exposing experience; 0 if the text is assessable but has no such admission (mere opinions or first-person statements that aren't self-exposing don't count). Quoted or reported words of others are ignored unless the OP explicitly adopts them as their own admission. Excludes as evidence any view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the view changed; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is neither evidence nor an outcome. Does not try to reconstruct an initial version. Null if title and argument are both missing or malformed.
